scope: Pinned public-header binding generation on x86_64 Linux. Recorded benchmark outputs are associated with independent C/FFI, bindgen API, and all-record layout results by SHA256. Exact generated Rust APIs remain different.

benchmark_configuration.toucan_build: Release build with the default system allocator.
benchmark_configuration.order: Shuffled within each iteration with seed 20260907.
benchmark_configuration.timing_scope: Subprocess startup and binding generation, including output capture. Untimed report discovery and C/FFI/equivalence checks are excluded.
benchmark_configuration.memory_scope: Linux /usr/bin/time maximum resident set size for each subprocess; reported summaries are medians of those maxima.

fb9169cd65b4d1ce6181d86ee34d5631d34288c8.meaning: Clean checkout commit recorded by the benchmark harness. Production Rust source and manifest SHA256 values are extracted from that commit; no claim is made about later working-tree state.

limitations: Exact API equivalence is false. Accepted constant, callback, helper-name, additional-constant, and private-bitfield-storage differences remain visible in the comparison evidence.
One machine and four pinned projects do not establish performance across headers, target platforms, allocators, compiler versions, or cold caches.
Binary/header hashes do not cover headers used only by bindgen or shared libraries. CPU affinity is controlled; frequency and host load are not.
The 5444-check native C/FFI run and the 858-check all-record run are separate and have overlapping layout coverage; their counts should not be added as unique assertions.
